subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Which open Z.AI User-Agent fix should be the canonical landing path, and is source/test evidence enough without a maintainer-provided Coding Plan key?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still lack the explicit OpenClaw User-Agent, while several open PRs close this issue; choosing the canonical PR and waiving or supplying live provider proof requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Land one narrow PR
options.body: Select the focused candidate with regression coverage, require redacted live Coding Plan proof if credentials are available, or explicitly waive the live-provider gap before merge.

options.title: Wait for live credentials
options.body: Keep candidate PRs paused until someone can run the exact Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection smoke.

options.title: Close duplicates after merge
options.body: After one candidate merges, close the remaining duplicate PRs against this issue as superseded.

recommendation.title: Land one narrow PR
recommendation.body: Select the focused candidate with regression coverage, require redacted live Coding Plan proof if credentials are available, or explicitly waive the live-provider gap before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the endpoint auto-detection feature and is the live issue assignee, making him the best available owner for the proof and landing choice.
